messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The webhooks service ships only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-17]
- On 2025-05-23, the Ember team observed that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout, and flagged it since the webhooks service is not the Ember team's service. [valid 2025-05-23 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-05-23]
- The webhooks service depends on the event bus for outbound events. [valid 2025-01-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-17]
- On 2025-10-22, Team Dune agreed that the webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review. [decision; valid 2025-10-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-22]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then, and the Ember team never held it. [valid 2025-07-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-04-webhooks-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with the Ember team; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-06-20 to 2025-07-04; recorded by handover/2025-06-20-webhooks]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-28, the webhooks service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-03-28 to 2025-06-20; recorded by handover/2025-03-28-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhooks service lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-28; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-28-webhooks]
- The INC-2026-003 review on 2026-01-22 decided that the webhooks service will require an idempotency key on every delivery because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one. [decision; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- INC-2025-017 was an incident affecting the auth gateway on 2025-07-27. [valid 2025-08-01 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- On 2026-05-25, Team Atlas observed that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2]
- INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- As of 2025-11-20, dashboards and alerts for the event bus are being repointed. [valid 2025-11-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-20-event-bus]
- The webhook dispatcher's deploy window is on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- As of 2026-03-04, the webhook dispatcher remains a Team Dune service. [valid 2026-03-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-04]
- As of 2026-04-16, the ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC; the old Wednesday 09:00-11:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-16]
    earlier: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to 2026-04-16; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-18]
- On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [decision; valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
- Dashboards and alerts for the catalog service are being repointed as of 2025-06-16. [valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-16-catalog]
- The event bus deploys on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- On 2026-05-18, the Ember team observed that the auth gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18-2]
- Dashboards and alerts for the resizer are being repointed as of 2025-04-29. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]

Question: Who was responsible for webhooks on 2025-04-05?

message.reasoning:
The question asks who was responsible for webhooks on 2025-04-05.

Looking at the ownership history:
- The webhooks service lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-28]
- As of 2025-03-28, the webhooks service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-03-28 to 2025-06-20]
- As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with the Ember team. [valid 2025-06-20 to 2025-07-04]
- As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then... [valid 2025-07-04 to now]

On 2025-04-05, the valid entry is "As of 2025-03-28, the webhooks service lives with Team Atlas" (valid 2025-03-28 to 2025-06-20).

So the answer is Team Atlas.
